businessAndExperienceBoundary.businessMeaning: A payroll statutory operator reviews signed country-pack metadata and safely activates one approved insurance pack for one trusted legal-entity and pay-group population; payroll support then views immutable social-insurance outcomes with the exact activated policy version.
operationalQuestions: Which installed statutory country packs are current, approved and safe to activate for this trusted Payroll scope?
Which immutable worker payroll results contain an exact social-insurance fact and policy lineage, and where is tax data still unavailable?
businessAndExperienceBoundary.primaryAction: Activate the selected owner-resolved country pack after exact evidence, current revision, authorization, SoD and step-up validation.
businessAndExperienceBoundary.visibility: The frontend feature may be authored only in its bounded root. Shell route, menu, navigation policy, shared UI integration and i18n admission remain central-control work after module result review. With the feature default OFF and zero enrolled tenants, the pages make zero owner calls and are not visible.

IAQ-026.actionExposure: Expose exactly one hris.action.pay.country.pack.activate action only when all three field groups are VIEW, lifecycle is APPROVED or SUSPENDED, one current nonnegative activation revision is present and preliminary PEP-PAY-028 allows the exact owner-resolved population. Otherwise availableActions is empty.
IAQ-026.actionIdentity: targetResourcePublicId equals itemPublicId byte-for-byte and resolvedHref equals /api/payroll/v1/country-packs/{itemPublicId}/activate with the UUID present exactly once and no query or fragment.

IAQ-048.taxResultBoundary: TAX_RESULT belongs to PAY-005 and is omitted. Otherwise valid result rows are PARTIAL with one typed tax-producer-unavailable failure until PAY-005 joins the same workerResultId.
IAQ-048.forbiddenActionDerivation: workerResultId, POLICY_VERSION.policyKey, masked values, title, status, deep link, hidden state, query input and caller headers can never supply packId.

activationCommand.trustedCommandBinding: Gateway binds canonical packId and reconstructs X-DWP-Expected-Object-Version from accepted strong If-Match evidence for the exact PAY-003 action route. Caller-provided authority is stripped.

authorization.population: exactly one owner-resolved LEGAL_ENTITY and one PAY_GROUP
authorization.riskAndStepUp: HIGH and STEPUP-MGMT-HIGH-V1 bound to COUNTRY_PACK/packId and expected activation revision

activationCommand.optimisticConcurrency: If-Match must be one strong quoted canonical nonnegative activation revision and must equal trusted X-DWP-Expected-Object-Version and the current installed-pack row version. Weak, stale or mismatched input returns 409 before activation mutation.
activationCommand.scopeResolution: The owner loads packId under RLS, requires exactly one same-tenant installed snapshot bound to one legal entity and one pay group, and returns opaque 404 before evidence, version or lifecycle disclosure for unknown, cross-tenant or unauthorized identifiers.
activationCommand.idempotency: Scope by trusted tenantId, subjectPrincipalPublicId, PAY_COUNTRY_PACK_ACTIVATE and Idempotency-Key. Hash canonical schema version, packId, expected revision, normalized body and owner-resolved scope. Same digest replays the durable receipt; a different digest is 409 before mutation; concurrent reservation has one winner.
activationCommand.success: PayrollCommandReceipt.v1 with ACCEPTED or SUCCEEDED only after durable atomic activation-version, receipt and audit-outbox commit
ownerOrder: resolve trusted tenant, subject and STATUTORY_CONFIGURATION purpose
load packId under RLS and resolve exactly one legal-entity and pay-group scope
reserve or replay the exact subject-and-action idempotency receipt
lock the installed snapshot and compare strong current revision
revalidate lifecycle, signature, official references, golden-pack digest and statutory approval evidence
re-evaluate population, responsibility, dynamic SoD and current HIGH step-up
invoke typed verification and country-rule ports, whose production adapters remain fail closed
atomically append activation version, durable receipt and audit-outbox event

signedPackAndProviderBoundary.transitionRule: Every transition appends a revision under compare-and-set. RETIRED is terminal, SUSPENDED->ACTIVE is the only reactivation path, and every unlisted skipped, reverse or same-state transition returns 409 before persistence.
activationEvidence: canonical payload digest plus supported signature algorithm and key identifier
successful signature verification against a separately admitted trusted key set
officialReferenceSet exactly equal to stored approved evidence
goldenPackDigest exactly equal to stored approved evidence
one same-tenant approved statutoryApprovalReceiptId in the exact pack scope
statutory approver different from the recorded pack installer
effectiveDate equal to the snapshot lower bound and no overlap with an ever-activated winner in the exact scope
current step-up, entitlement, action, population, field, purpose and audit decisions
signedPackAndProviderBoundary.immutability: Pack identity/version, scope, jurisdiction, payload/artifact/signature digests, algorithm/key ID, compatibility and policy schema versions, approval evidence, lower bound, installer, approver and activation facts are immutable after activation. Only an open effectiveTo may be forward-closed once.
signedPackAndProviderBoundary.typedPorts: Define typed signature verification, statutory-approval and country-rule provider ports with fail-closed production adapters and deterministic conformance doubles.

calculationAndResultBoundary.forbiddenInference: Generic DEDUCTION lines or totals cannot be relabeled, split or copied as TAX_RESULT or SOCIAL_INSURANCE.
calculationAndResultBoundary.socialInsuranceFact: A typed provider outcome writes one immutable fact linked to the exact tenant, run, attempt, workerResultId, source result lines, pack snapshot, activation revision, policy version, PostedMoney amount/currency and canonical result digest.
calculationAndResultBoundary.identityAndUniqueness: The stable IAQ item identity remains workerResultId. Exactly zero or one aggregate exists per tenantId and workerResultId; activationRevision and policyVersion are lineage attributes, not uniqueness dimensions.
calculationAndResultBoundary.lineage: Use the exact V50 composite foreign key (tenant_id, run_id, attempt_no, worker_result_id). Every source line contributes to at most one aggregate and all amounts reconcile exactly.

migration.activationCondition: A later append-only active-lease successor must bind the fresh clean backend worktree receipt before the start token is issued.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Feature defaults OFF with zero enrolled tenants; hidden pages make zero owner calls and direct URLs fail closed.
packId owner-resolves exactly one trusted tenant, LEGAL_ENTITY and PAY_GROUP scope; caller tenant or population authority is rejected.
The closed activation transport enforces canonical UUID, exact body, exact purpose, idempotency, strong If-Match and current HIGH step-up before mutation.
Signature, official reference, golden pack and statutory approval evidence all match the installed snapshot; missing real provider material fails closed.
Lifecycle, SoD, immutable lineage, monotonic retirement and nonoverlapping half-open effective periods are enforced in service and PostgreSQL.
Exact subject-and-action idempotency returns the original receipt for the same digest and 409 for a different digest with no duplicate effects.
Activation version, durable receipt and audit outbox append atomically; rollback, lost response and retry leave a deterministic recoverable outcome.
IAQ-026 returns only COUNTRY_PACK_METADATA, STATUTORY_RULE and ACTIVATION_STATUS with exact query-state, cursor, policy and field-decision invariants.

Social-insurance facts are immutable, PostedMoney-safe, unique per tenantId and stable workerResultId with an exact V50 composite foreign key, retain activation and policy as lineage attributes, and exactly reconcile their source lines; generic DEDUCTIONS are never reinterpreted.

IAQ-048 keeps workerResultId as itemPublicId, returns SOCIAL_INSURANCE and POLICY_VERSION only for PAY-003, and omits TAX_RESULT with a typed PARTIAL failure until PAY-005 can join the same stable item identity.

The IAQ-026 settings workbench exposes the exact resolved country-pack activation action only for a safe owner-resolved pack item and renders loading, empty, complete, partial, unavailable, forbidden, retry and step-up states accessibly and responsively. IAQ-048 renders the same non-action states for result data and exposes no PAY-003 action.
Fresh and V52-to-V53 PostgreSQL migration tests prove RLS, constraints, immutability, overlap, SoD, idempotency, atomicity and rollback without editing prior migrations.
Authorization-negative and tenant-isolation tests prove opaque cross-scope failure, stripped caller authority, exact purpose and current-policy re-evaluation.
Targeted recovery and telemetry tests cover provider unavailable, signature failure, stale CAS, duplicate request, audit publication retry and result unknown; no repository-wide suite is required.
